decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has had a page of its own in both years, which signals that it meets management's aspirations and is a core part of the range, so a small firm with limited slack has no problem that would prompt search and every reason to keep it.

The hyaluronic serum has been mentioned in both years without being promoted, which suggests modest but acceptable results, and in a popular category with low carrying costs it stays unless a clear shortfall appears.

The cleansing oil appears to replace the dropped cleansing milk, a result of earlier problemistic search, so management will give it time to prove itself, though its results are still uncertain and a small firm's limited slack keeps the risk of dropping it moderate.
